newsitem.title: USA: A.H. Belo swaps Seattle station.
newsitem.headline: A.H. Belo swaps Seattle station.

text.p: A.H. Belo Corp said Thursday it has reached an agreement with Viacom Inc's Paramount Stations Group Inc and Cox Communications Inc broadcasting unit that ultimately would lead to it exchanging its Seattle UPN television affiliate for a CBS-TV affiliate in St. Louis, Missouri.
Under the deal, Cox Broadcasting Inc will own the UPN affiliate, KIRO-TV in Seattle.

Paramount will own KSTW-TV in Seattle, which is currently owned by Gaylord Entertainment Co. Gaylord is under contract to sell KSTW to Cox and has consented to the arrangement, Belo said in a statement.
Belo would then own KMOV-TV in St. Louis, Mo.
Belo said in September it intended to sell or exchange KIRO as part of its acquisition of the Providence Journal Co, which owns the NBC affiliated station in Seattle, KING-TV.
Federal regulations prohibit a company from owning multiple television stations in a single market.
